title: Rami bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 20b, and Hyman writes that it seems the text should read Rami bar Abba, or else he is Ami bar Avin, who is mentioned in Keritot 20a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rami bar Abba and Ami bar Avin are Hyman’s alternative proposed readings or identifications, not adopted authority links.

The whole Davidson Shabbat 20b paragraph has Rami bar Avin explaining itran, and a separate paragraph on that page has Rami bar Abba. The whole Keritot 20a final paragraph has Ami bar Avin together with Rav Chananya bar Avin. Hyman’s ‘it seems/should read/or’ alternatives remain tentative and attributed, without identifying these people or giving them a common father.
